args.text:
Fixed-limit hold'em strategy (A03):
1. Preflop: play strong hands (pairs, AK/AQ/AJ suited, broadways) from any seat; add suited connectors and small pairs in late position or when limped to. Fold weak offsuit junk out of early position.
2. Postflop: bet/raise strong made hands and good draws for value; check-call medium hands; fold weak hands to aggression without a draw.
3. Don't bluff into multiple opponents; bluff semi-bluff only with strong draws, mainly heads-up or when checked to.
4. Raise with premium hands; avoid cold-calling multiple raises without a strong hand.
5. Watch opponents: note who raises wide, who folds to pressure, and adjust (call down loose-aggressive players lighter; bluff more against tight folders).
6. Keep notes on results per game and revise this brain after each game.
